Durable review reproductions: these four independent contracts failed on both JVM and Scala.js against e071e83b3a23bc6f304b1e72625d6281d9cfc9ba. Preserve their mathematical assertions when moving them to permanent shared tests; adapt status expectations to the repaired ADT. Existing laws passed (24 JVM PHRF, 15 focused JS); this is evidence of missing cases, not prior test failures.

```scala
package scalafim.fmri.fit.profile

import scalafim.fmri.design.hrf.{HrfKernelBasis, KernelBasisSpec}
import scalafim.fmri.hrf.PositiveSeconds
import scalafim.fmri.hrf.family.{GaussianFamily, ShapeChart}

/** Review-only independent contracts; this file is outside the checkout. */
class PhrfReviewProbeSuite extends munit.FunSuite:
  private final class Quartic extends ShapeObjective:
    val grid = NodeGrid(ShapeChart(("x", -1.0, 1.0)), Vector(3))
    def amplitudeCount: Int = 1
    def energy(x: Double): Double =
      val z = x - 0.2
      5.0 + z * z + 10.0 * z * z * z * z
    def curvature(x: Double): Double = 2.0 + 120.0 * (x - 0.2) * (x - 0.2)
    private def fill(x: Double, out: ProfileJetBuffer): Boolean =
      val z = x - 0.2
      out.energy = energy(x)
      out.gradient(0) = 2.0 * z + 40.0 * z * z * z
      out.hessian(0) = curvature(x)
      out.amplitudes(0) = 1.0
      out.curvature = CurvatureStatus.PositiveDefinite
      true
    def scoreNode(node: Int): Double = energy(grid.point(node)(0))
    def jetAtNode(node: Int, out: ProfileJetBuffer): Boolean = fill(grid.point(node)(0), out)
    def jetAt(coordinates: Array[Double], out: ProfileJetBuffer): Boolean = fill(coordinates(0), out)
    def energyAt(coordinates: Array[Double], out: ProfileJetBuffer): Double =
      out.energy = energy(coordinates(0))
      out.amplitudes(0) = 1.0
      out.energy

  test("reported curvature and admission belong to the returned point"):
    val objective = new Quartic
    val result = new ShapeDecoder(objective,
      DecodeBudget(coarseStride = 1, maxNewtonSteps = 1, maxJets = 1, weakSdLimit = Vector(0.7)),
      None, 1.0).decode(new DecoderCounters)
    val actualHessian = objective.curvature(result.coordinates(0))
    val actualSd = math.sqrt(2.0 / actualHessian)
    println(s"REVIEW curvature: x=${result.coordinates(0)}, reportedH=${result.dataHessian(0)}, actualH=$actualHessian, reportedSd=${result.conditionalSd(0)}, actualSd=$actualSd, status=${result.status}")
    assertEqualsDouble(result.dataHessian(0), actualHessian, 1e-12)

  test("exhausted refinement budget is not reported as Accepted"):
    val result = new ShapeDecoder(new Quartic,
      DecodeBudget(coarseStride = 1, maxNewtonSteps = 2, maxJets = 1, maxExactEvaluations = 0),
      None, 1.0).decode(new DecoderCounters)
    println(s"REVIEW budget: x=${result.coordinates(0)}, steps=${result.newtonSteps}, status=${result.status}")
    assertEquals(result.status, DecodeStatus.BudgetExceeded)

  test("the node scan includes the declared prior even when no refinement is requested"):
    val result = new ShapeDecoder(new Quartic,
      DecodeBudget(coarseStride = 1, maxNewtonSteps = 0),
      Some(ShapePrior(Vector(1.0), Vector(100.0))), 1.0).decode(new DecoderCounters)
    println(s"REVIEW prior: selectedNode=${result.node}, x=${result.coordinates(0)}; augmented grid energy is 105.056 at 0 versus 9.736 at 1")
    assertEquals(result.node, 2)

  test("a nonfinite response in the production Gram backend produces a refusal without an index exception"):
    val family = GaussianFamily.Default
    val step = PositiveSeconds(0.2).fold(e => fail(e.message), identity)
    val basis = HrfKernelBasis.compile(KernelBasisSpec(family, step, Vector(26, 21), tolerance = 1e-3, maxRank = 40))
      .fold(e => fail(e.message), identity)
    val m = basis.rank
    val gram = Array.tabulate(m * m)(i => if i / m == i % m then 1.0 else 0.0)
    val objective = new GramConditionObjective(new GramConditionJets(gram, 1, m, 2), basis, NodeGrid(family.chart, Vector(3, 3)))
    objective.pointAt(Array.fill(m)(Double.NaN), Double.NaN)
    val result = new ShapeDecoder(objective, DecodeBudget(), None, 1.0).decode(new DecoderCounters)
    assert(result.status != DecodeStatus.Accepted)
```
